messages:
anita: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for openstar-7B. Goal: get a baseline hosted/quantized bring-up and a first-pass quality gate by EOD Fri. TL;DR checklist below.

jon: +1. can you paste the checklist here so we can grab owners?

anita: Sure. High level checklist: 1) Quick smoke on fp16 baseline (sanity + perf/latency), 2) q4/q8 quant experiments with representative prompts, 3) run eval harness across our onboard prompt suites, 4) compare to redwood-1.5B baseline, 5) pick canary config + rollout policy. I'll drop commands.

li: assigning myself q-experiments (2). i'll run q4_0 and q8_0 on the small eval set. ETA 2hrs.

eva: i'll take the eval harness run (3) and aggregation (4). will need the suite mapping from devex.

anita: ci-bot: create job openstar-7B/onboard with tags [smoke,quant,eval]

ci-bot: job created: openstar-7B/onboard #42 — triggered by anita. Logs will appear in /ci/openstar-7B/42.

li: quick note: for quant experiments use the new quant runner flag to force KV-cache-friendly fallback: `--quant-fallback=kvcache-v2`. sample run:```bash
rw-serve bench --model=openstar-7B --dtype=q4_0 --batch-size=8 --seq=512 --quant-fallback=kvcache-v2 > q4_0_smoke.log 2>&1
```

li: initial perf: q4_0 avg token latency 18ms on A100-40GB (burst mem ok). q8_0 avg 22ms. fp16 baseline 15ms.

anita: good. eva, for the eval harness please run:```bash
rw-eval run --model=openstar-7B:q4_0 --suites=onboard/instruction-following.yaml,onboard/summarization.yaml,onboard/math.yaml --out=results/q4_0-onboard.json --parallel=4
```

eva: running now. I'll also run fp16 and redwood-1.5B as baselines for within-suite win-rate.

jon: For pass/fail gating we decided last sprint: overall quality delta vs redwood-1.5B must be >= -2% (aggregate win-rate), and no single suite drop >5%. Also hallucination FPR on QA suite must be <= 2x baseline. If quantization causes >3% failure on safety checks, fail.

anita: adding: latency SLO for hosted tier must be <= +20% of fp16 baseline at median p50; p95 must remain under 1.5x baseline or we don't canary. cost delta: q4 should reduce per-token cost by at least 30% vs fp16 to justify.

eva: results (first-pass): fp16 -> aggregate win-rate vs redwood-1.5B = +3.1%. q4_0 -> aggregate = -0.9%. q8_0 -> aggregate = +0.5%. Summarized metrics:
- instruction-following: fp16 +4.2, q4_0 -1.2, q8_0 +0.9
- summarization (Rouge-L): fp16 0.452, q4_0 0.440 (-2.7%), q8_0 0.447 (-1.1%)
- math (exact-match): fp16 71.3, q4_0 68.4 (-4.0%), q8_0 70.2 (-1.5%)
- hallucination QA FPR: fp16 1.1%, q4_0 2.4% (2.18x), q8_0 1.3%

li: math suite drop >3% for q4_0 — meh. Might be numeric fragility due to 8-bit quantization of norm weights. I can experiment with mixed-quant (q4+fp16 norm) in ~3hrs.

anita: based on the gating rules, q8_0 passes (aggregate within -2%? it's +0.5), q4_0 fails because math -4% and hallucination >2x. So we won't canary q4_0 to hosted.

jon: next steps: li try mixed-quant & disable weight-wise symmetric quant on Norm layers. eva re-run harness for that variant if li posts artifact. If new variant meets gates, plan a small canary: 5% traffic on dedicated pool for 24h with latency tracing.

li: noted. starting mixed-quant run and will push artifact to s3://redwood-artifacts/openstar-7B/mixed-q-20240503.tar.gz once done.

eva: also adding a deterministic eval for math with higher sample size (n=3 seeds) to reduce noise before final decision.

anita: thanks. I'll update the onboarding spreadsheet and set canary checklist: monitoring hooks, auto-fallback to redwood-1.5B, alert on p95>1.5x, and quality regression slack alert if suite drop >3%.

jon: can someone post the exact pass/fail text we'll attach to the PR? keeps reviewers aligned.

anita: PR blurb I'll use: "Onboard openstar-7B (q8_0 mixed-quant candidate). Eval harness against onboard suites shows aggregate win-rate +0.5% vs redwood-1.5B; per-suite regressions within accepted thresholds; hallucination FPR within 1.5x baseline. Meets latency and cost SLOs for canary. Approve for 5% canary on dedicated pool."

ci-bot: pipeline openstar-7B/onboard #42: build succeeded. Artifacts available: /ci/openstar-7B/42/artifacts/{model.tar.gz,eval-results.json}.

anita: Great work everyone. We'll reconvene after mixed-quant runs and deterministic math eval. If li posts artifact and eva thumbs up, I'll schedule canary for Tue morning. :thumbsup:
